description: This file defines functions and includes for handling HTTP/1.x protocol layer within the project, including sending and receiving headers, reading request bodies, and timeout checking.

methods.name: h1_send_1xx
methods.description: Sends a 1xx informational HTTP response to the client.

methods.name: h1_send_headers
methods.description: Sends HTTP headers for a request.

methods.name: h1_recv_headers
methods.description: Receives HTTP headers from the client.

methods.name: h1_reqbody_read
methods.description: Reads the request body from the client.

methods.name: h1_check_timeout
methods.description: Checks for timeout on a connection.
